Lessons.Title: End Behavior (Part 2)
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Comprehend how the sign of the leading coefficient of a polynomial function affects the end behavior. Create equations for polynomial functions with specific end behavior.

Changing the sign of the leading coefficient reverses the large-|x| sign of a polynomial. For -2x^3+7x, the far-left values grow positive and far-right values grow negative. State both the degree parity and leading sign before inferring behaviour.
